opener_concept: A counter on a square grid: slide it right/up (translation, recorded as a column vector), then fold the grid along the horizontal centre line (reflection). Common-sense arithmetic on the across/up numbers becomes the coordinate method; the four moves (slide, flip, turn, resize) are named.
